page.layout: One printed page on the scan, set sideways: a title block running across the upper-middle of the sheet, rotated about 90 degrees. Below and to the right is a vertical line of faint text. The strip of text at the far right edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
page.notes: The scan is rotated and very faint. The title "Principia Logicae" is read with some confidence; the second and third lines are largely illegible. A vertical line of smaller text in the centre-right and a bracketed group of small lines near the middle are too faint to read and are not transcribed. Text cut off at the right edge (fragments such as "pri", "fo", "fib", "ef") belongs to the adjacent page and is left out. Handwritten marks and show-through are not transcribed.
